🆕 Newly posted (Published: September 18, 2026)

Hanno City is recruiting 6 non-permanent accounting year staff members for the Citizen Tax Division.

【Eligibility】
Applicants must have office work experience and be able to use computers.

【Employment Period】
January 14 (Thursday), 2027 through May 17 (Monday), 2027

【Work Schedule】
Monday–Friday (excluding holidays)
10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. (lunch break 12:00 p.m. to 1:00 p.m.)

【Work Location】
Hanno City Hall main building

【Job Duties】
Organizing tax assessment documents for personal city and prefectural income tax, document and computer-based checking, answering phone calls for tax filing reservations, and similar tasks

【Pay】
Salary follows the regulations after the latest minimum wage revision (Reference: ¥133,901 per month as of September 16, 2025). Social insurance coverage included.

【Selection Method】
Interview

【How to Apply】
Bring your handwritten resume with a photo to the Citizen Tax Division in person by Friday, November 13. Mail applications are not accepted.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/somubu/shiminzeika/tokutyo/kyuyotokubetsuchoshu_shiminzei_kemminzei_sinrinkakyouzei/8517.html
